annotations.text:
Where this stands

The 13 vector masters are drawn and in the repo under brand/assets. I reconstructed them rather than extracting from the sheets, because an image generator cannot emit structured SVG — the fourth sheet would have been another sheet.

What is real now: flat vector, transparent, no gloss or shadow, named groups, and the whole set renders correctly at 16 through 128px on light and dark.

The three artboards on the lower row are the previous identity, kept for reference only. They are superseded.

Not done yet

1. The 16px tray glyphs. These masters are the spec, not the shipped art — scaled-down vector is exactly what failed at 16px twice. Each style and state gets hand-authored on the pixel grid, flat and hard-edged.

2. The trayIconStyle setting: robot / ring / a-mark, defaulting to robot, and the app tokens moving to #FF8F00 and #B3181F.

3. The .ico and PNG icon set, rasterised from the logo master.

All three are unblocked now — say the word.
